response.sql:
WITH rental_payment_totals AS (
  SELECT r.rental_id, i.store_id, SUM(p.amount) AS payment_total
  FROM rental r
  JOIN inventory i ON i.inventory_id = r.inventory_id
  JOIN payment p ON p.rental_id = r.rental_id
  GROUP BY r.rental_id, i.store_id
), overall_average AS (
  SELECT AVG(payment_total) AS avg_payment_total
  FROM rental_payment_totals
), qualifying_rentals AS (
  SELECT rpt.store_id, rpt.payment_total, oa.avg_payment_total
  FROM rental_payment_totals rpt
  CROSS JOIN overall_average oa
  WHERE rpt.payment_total > oa.avg_payment_total
)
SELECT store_id,
       SUM(payment_total) AS qualifying_rentals_payment_total,
       AVG(payment_total - avg_payment_total) AS avg_excess_overall_average
FROM qualifying_rentals
GROUP BY store_id;

assumptions.assumption: Rentals with no linked payment are excluded: the request totals payments linked to rentals, and averages ignore missing values.
